notes: kb/Work PB571 LANDED. The refuter's one leaking half is closed. Sentence 2 - 'The class and category of an index data item are index' - is now carried through the CLASS-CONDITION site as well as the MOVE (COBOL0809) and DISPLAY (pb148) ones: ConditionBinder.CheckClassConditionOperand asks ISO 8.8.4.4.3 SR1 of EVERY alternative before the alternative's own rules, through ClassConditionModel.Sr1Refusal, which delegates to ItemCategory.IsIndexMessageTagObjectOrPointer (13.18.60.3 SR4's phrase reader) and IntrinsicArgumentRules.ClassOf (the 8.5.2.1 Table-2 classifier) rather than writing a third class list. Measured on the fixed build: `01 IX USAGE INDEX. SET IX TO 3  IF IX IS NUMERIC` now draws COBOL2200 at every edition where it previously compiled clean and PRINTED 'IX IS NUMERIC'; the same refusal now reaches the EVALUATE selection subject's class test, a USAGE POINTER operand and an index-NAME operand (all three measured). Sentences 1, 3 and 4 were already held by the adjudication and are unchanged.
